notes: One entry per stock. sector_index = key of the row in nifty-sectors-inputs-monthly.csv whose PE is the sector benchmark for V1 (NIFTY50 when the sector model has no matching index). type: nonfin | lender | insurer | holdco. lender: adds V4 (P/B vs ROE), lender ROE anchors, skips Q2 leverage. insurer/holdco: skip Q2 (consolidated borrowings are not the parent's). A ticker in the inputs CSV that is not listed here is still scored, as nonfin vs NIFTY50, and flagged. anchors override [cheap, rich] per indicator.
universe_target: Nifty 500 (NSE ind_nifty500list.csv). This config hand-configures the 50 Nifty 50 constituents (30-Sep-2026); the rest are auto-classified by scripts/fetch_stock_fundamentals.py.
